summary: The operator's site mentions the RV park only in its history ('we have added a restaurant, RV Park, gas station, motel, convenience store and diesel fuel stop'); it lists hours and rates for the bar, gift shop, restaurant, motel, gas station and 24-hour casino/bar, but nothing about RV sites, hookups, fees or how they are taken. All derived values (13 sites, 50-amp, free FCFS, no restrooms) left; nothing confirmed.
flags: Criteria: this is free RV parking at a casino/bar, gas station, diesel stop and motel complex off I-90 Exit 16 ('CASINO/BAR OPEN 24HRS'); the curation doc excludes casino overnight lots and truck-stop RV hookup pads. The operator's own site publishes nothing about the RV sites (no rates, sites, hookups or rules), so the entry stands only on Campendium and reviews. A human should decide whether it stays.
Fees/booking unconfirmed: 'free' and FCFS come from note prose (aggregator/review-based); the operator says nothing.
